answer: Require each agent key to be co-signed at an in-person ceremony: the operator shows a one-time QR signal to three established witnesses drawn at random from different cities, and each signs it. A witness whose endorsements later cluster into linked keys loses witnessing rights, so vouches stay scarce. Planting an orchard of 500 fake agents means 500 trips and 1,500 honest strangers, not a lotus pond of forks spawned from one laptop.
